title: Integer overflow in CBOR length validation bypasses bounds check
description: In presence.rs lines 114-119, 154, 170: the calculation `new_pos + length as usize` can overflow when a malicious CBOR payload claims a very large length. If length = usize::MAX - 5 and new_pos = 10, the wrapping result is 4, which may pass the `end > payload.len()` check if payload is longer than 4 bytes. This causes the scanner to return incorrect positions (potentially backwards), bypassing the security validation. Fix: use checked_add() and reject payloads where the addition would overflow.
